hero.title: OpenVPN3 GUI
hero.subtitle: A lightweight desktop GUI for managing OpenVPN3 connections on Linux.
features.title: Features
features.import.title: Import Configurations
features.import.desc: Import .ovpn/.conf files with name validation and duplicate detection.
features.connect.title: Connect & Disconnect
features.connect.desc: Manage your VPN sessions with one click. Connect, disconnect, and remove configs easily.
features.stats.title: Session Statistics
features.stats.desc: Per-session download/upload speed, ping, total bytes, and connection uptime.
features.multi.title: Multiple Sessions
features.multi.desc: Connect to multiple VPN configurations simultaneously.
features.titlebar.title: Custom Titlebar
features.titlebar.desc: Native-looking custom titlebar integrated with the app design.
features.status.title: Real-time Status
features.status.desc: Monitor virtual IP, live traffic stats, and openvpn3 version at a glance.
features.tray.title: System Tray
features.tray.desc: Minimize to tray on close. Click to restore. VPN stays connected in background.
features.theme.title: Dark & Light Themes
features.theme.desc: Switch between dark and light themes to match your desktop environment.
features.i18n.title: Multi-language
features.i18n.desc: Available in English, Português (BR), and Español. Easily extensible.
screenshots.title: Screenshots
install.title: Installation
install.prereq: Prerequisite: openvpn3 must be installed and configured.
install.deb.title: .deb Package
install.deb.desc: For Ubuntu, Linux Mint, and Debian-based distros.
install.appimage.title: AppImage
install.appimage.desc: Universal format. Works on any Linux distro.
